    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:15.959
    | text      = Local candy, so good, Coffee Crisp.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:18.959
    | text      = This is why we got to have production meetings
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:20.959
    | text      = before the show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:21.959
    | text      = We got to make sure, we got to,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:22.959
    | text      = if we had somebody there who's like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:24.959
    | text      = all right, here's the packet that we put in my pocket.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:27.959
    | text      = That's how you say it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:28.959
    | text      = Packet in the pocket.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:29.959
    | text      = Oh God, packet of pockets.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:30.959
    | text      = I was digging in there and I accidentally found a Mamba
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:33.959
    | text      = that I forgot was in there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:36.959
    | text      = Similar shape.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:38.959
    | text      = So anyway, how are you all doing, Canada?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:47.959
    | text      = I swear I didn't come up with the Toronto Canada A.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:50.959
    | text      = I didn't do that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:51.959
    | text      = We had nothing to do with it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:52.959
    | text      = I probably could, I probably would have.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:54.959
    | text      = When I saw it, I'm like, I didn't do that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:57.959
    | text      = But I probably would have.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:58.959
    | text      = Here's what I've noticed about Toronto so far is that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:02.959
    | text      = y'all put that on there like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:04.959
    | text      = well, of course they're going to make fun of us.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:07.959
    | text      = But we don't want them to feel bad about it,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:09.959
    | text      = so we'll take care of it in advance for you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:13.959
    | text      = Toronto Canada A, that's what you guys like to call us,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:15.959
    | text      = you fun Americans.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:19.959
    | text      = It pricks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:22.959
    | text      = So Jordan, today we have an episode to go over.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:24.959
    | text      = That is the reason for the season.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:26.959
    | text      = Indeed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:27.959
    | text      = And so today we're going to be going over February 2nd, 2014.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:32.959
    | text      = All right, all right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:34.959
    | text      = Hey, happy birthday!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:36.959
    | text      = I love it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:37.959
    | text      = I love it that a date...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:38.959
    | text      = Are you ten?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:40.959
    | text      = Get out!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:44.959
    | text      = Every single time we say a date,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:46.959
    | text      = everyone is like, ooh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:49.959
    | text      = There's such a mysteriousness to it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:52.959
    | text      = Do you have any idea what was going on?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:53.959
    | text      = February 2nd, 2014.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:55.959
    | text      = February 2nd, 2-2-14.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:58.959
    | text      = Two plus two plus one equals four.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:00.959
    | text      = It doesn't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:02.959
    | text      = I almost freaked out there for a second.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:05.959
    | text      = No, no idea.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:06.959
    | text      = Because I almost just said May 2nd,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:08.959
    | text      = so I definitely have no idea what's going on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:11.959
    | text      = No, it's not May 2nd.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:12.959
    | text      = May 2nd did not come on February 2nd.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:15.959
    | text      = Was it a leap year?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:16.959
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:17.959
    | text      = Was it? I don't know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:19.959
    | text      = So here we are, Jordan, in the great land of Canada.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:22.959
    | text      = I was putting together the episode.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:24.959
    | text      = I'd like to try and do something a little bit special
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:26.959
    | text      = that's relevant to the places that we're going to,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:30.959
    | text      = like something in the city's history, something in that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:34.960
    | text      = I started to think about it,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:36.960
    | text      = and I don't know anything about Canada.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:40.960
    | text      = I don't know shit about y'all's history.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:42.960
    | text      = I was sitting around thinking,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:43.960
    | text      = and I'm like, Dudley Do-Right's from here, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:47.960
    | text      = Do we do his birthday?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:48.960
    | text      = Fuck, I don't know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:50.960
    | text      = I like Rocky and Bullwinkle as one cartoon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:52.960
    | text      = Sure, sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:53.960
    | text      = Were they Canadian?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:54.960
    | text      = No, no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:56.960
    | text      = I bet they were.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:59.960
    | text      = But why would they be if they made a big deal
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:01.960
    | text      = out of Dudley Do-Right being a Canadian mountain?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:03.960
    | text      = Sure, sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:04.960
    | text      = Here's what's even more pressing,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:06.960
    | text      = is if they're Canadian, why are the Russians after them?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:09.960
    | text      = Ooh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:11.960
    | text      = Like, you guys didn't laugh enough,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:12.960
    | text      = so you feel like you might know a reason?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:16.960
    | text      = Shit, you don't remember what we were up to in the 90s, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:20.960
    | text      = We must get moussins quero.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:22.960
    | text      = Also, that cartoon's, like, from the 50s.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:24.960
    | text      = Okay. All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:26.960
    | text      = They've remade it a few times.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:28.960
    | text      = I do not understand time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:30.960
    | text      = So I was thinking about it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:31.960
    | text      = I don't know shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:32.960
    | text      = Maple syrup.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:34.960
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:35.960
    | text      = I got nothing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:36.960
    | text      = And so I was trying to scan my memories
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:39.960
    | text      = and think about what I would imagine
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:41.960
    | text      = was the most important day in Canadian history.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:45.960
    | text      = And I came up with October 5, 2004.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:50.960
    | text      = That was the day that time stands still,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:52.960
    | text      = the episode of Degrassi where Drake got shot by Rick.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:57.960
    | text      = The first error.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:02.960
    | text      = It has to have been the most important day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:05.960
    | text      = It really does.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:07.960
    | text      = It really does. It resonates still.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:09.960
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:10.960
    | text      = Unfortunately, every episode from October 5th on Alex's show sucked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:16.960
    | text      = Thankfully, that was a two-part episode,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:18.960
    | text      = so I had another shot at this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:19.960
    | text      = Maybe October 12th would work.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:22.960
    | text      = But it did not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:24.960
    | text      = But then I realized those were the Canadian air dates for those shows.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:31.960
    | text      = Maybe I could cover the days they aired in the United States.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:34.960
    | text      = Of course.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:35.960
    | text      = When I, in theory, watched them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:37.960
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:38.960
    | text      = Unfortunately, those dates, December 3rd and 10th,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:40.960
    | text      = also sucked on Infowars pretty much every year.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:44.960
    | text      = I felt defeated and like I had hit a dead end.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:47.960
    | text      = But then I remembered that two seasons later,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:50.960
    | text      = JT got murdered at a house party on Degrassi.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:53.960
    | text      = What the fuck is happening on Degrassi?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:56.960
    | text      = Well, see, what happened was that JT started dating Mia,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:01.960
    | text      = who was from the rival school, Lakehurst.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:04.960
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:05.960
    | text      = And Mia had previously to this dated bad boy Johnny DeMarco.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:09.960
    | text      = Bad boy Johnny DeMarco?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:11.960
    | text      = He turned his life around a little bit after the murder.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:13.960
    | text      = Oh, that's nice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:14.960
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:15.960
    | text      = That's nice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:16.960
    | text      = After the murder?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:17.960
    | text      = That he committed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:18.960
    | text      = He didn't commit the murder.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:19.960
    | text      = It was his friend who committed the murder.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:20.960
    | text      = Oh, okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:21.960
    | text      = It wasn't like, oh, well, hey, listen, it's Canadian.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:23.960
    | text      = He only killed one person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:24.960
    | text      = He was there, though.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:25.960
    | text      = He was at the house party.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:26.960
    | text      = I'm deeply ashamed I can't remember the name of the kid
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:28.960
    | text      = who actually did the stabbing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:32.960
    | text      = He didn't have a name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:33.960
    | text      = He did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:34.960
    | text      = Point of order?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:36.960
    | text      = Maybe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:37.960
    | text      = Point of order?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:38.960
    | text      = Maybe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:39.960
    | text      = That's what I'll say.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:40.960
    | text      = So I felt like that was probably like a culturally seismic event
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:43.960
    | text      = here whenever JT got stabbed at that house party
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:46.960
    | text      = because he was dating Mia, who previously dated Johnny DeMarco.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:49.960
    | text      = Naturally.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:50.960
    | text      = Unfortunately, the Canadian and American air dates
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:52.960
    | text      = for those episodes also sucked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:57.960
    | text      = But then I remembered that the episode after JT gets murdered.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:02.960
    | text      = Sure. The fallout from JT's murder.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:05.960
    | text      = Everyone's dealing with the murder.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:06.960
    | text      = Of course.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:07.960
    | text      = It's an emotionally fraught episode.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:09.960
    | text      = His best friend Toby kisses Liberty, who had had a baby with JT previously.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:15.960
    | text      = And then they broke up because he was stealing pills from the pharmacy
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:18.960
    | text      = he worked at to sell on the black market in order to pay for his family.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:23.960
    | text      = Liberty was like, I don't want any more of this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:25.960
    | text      = But they still had feelings for each other.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:27.960
    | text      = And then after JT was stabbed, Toby kissed her.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:29.960
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:30.960
    | text      = It was weird.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:31.960
    | text      = That's a lot going on for a high school.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:34.960
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:35.960
    | text      = My high school.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:37.960
    | text      = It was the go-thariest show on television is how they sold it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:41.960
    | text      = The go-thariest show on television.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:43.960
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:44.960
    | text      = So I also considered maybe Instant Star because I watched that too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:48.960
    | text      = You all made that one too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:50.960
    | text      = That's your fault.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:52.960
    | text      = No, people do not care for Instant Star.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.960
    | text      = That was a show that was like American Idol.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:58.960
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:59.960
    | text      = But it wasn't like it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
